data.name: Beatlash: Survival
data.detailed_description:
A horde survivor that plays your music.

PUT ON A SONG. THE WORLD MOVES TO IT

The horde walks in on the beat. Your guns answer on the beat. The floor, the lights, the whole ruined city pulses along with it.

You stop watching the screen and start listening to the fight.

AND THEN THE DROP HITS

You've been holding it. The build climbs, the enemies keep coming, you're one hit from gone.

Then the beat lands and you land with it, and everything in front of you turns to light.

That's the whole game. Chasing that moment, over and over, for five minutes at a time.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Every weapon has its own pulse. Some hammer constantly, some wait and hit like a truck. Pick four, and what comes out of it is a rhythm nobody else is playing.

Between waves, you get a choice. Then another. Then another. By the end of a good run you've built something ridiculous and you know exactly how you got there.

NEVER PUNISHED FOR MISSING

Hit the beat and you hit twice as hard. Miss it and you still hit.

No failed notes. No broken chains. Never played a rhythm game in your life? Doesn't matter. You'll feel it before you understand it.

NOW USE YOUR OWN MUSIC

Load any song off your drive and it becomes the battlefield.

The track you play on repeat. The one from that summer. The one you'd never admit to. Every one of them fights differently, and you already know exactly which one you're trying first.

SOMEONE IS RE-WRITING THE SONG

Something out there is changing the music, and it's getting louder.

Put on your headphones. Feel the beat. Survive.

data.short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 630 / NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 550 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
